report.title: Your report is ready
report.subtitle: Here is a simple explanation of your report, written in plain language.
report.analysis_unavailable_desc: We could not find this report. It may have been deleted or the link may be incorrect.
report.analysis_failed: We could not read this report
report.analysis_failed_desc: CareAI was unable to read the file you uploaded. The file may be corrupted, password-protected, or contain no readable text. Please try uploading a clear, text-based PDF.
report.analyzing_desc: CareAI is going through your report step by step. This usually takes about 10–20 seconds.
report.preparing: Writing a simple summary for you
report.normal_results_desc: These results are within the range shown on your report.
report.no_results: No test results could be read from this report.
report.questions_heading: Questions you can ask your doctor
report.questions_extra: Is there anything else in my results I should know about?
report.normal_results_toggle_show: Show all results within the range
report.cbc_explanation: A CBC (Complete Blood Count) is one of the most common blood tests. It checks different parts of your blood — including red blood cells, white blood cells, hemoglobin, and platelets. Doctors use it to get a general picture of your health.
report.key_findings_heading: Things worth discussing with your doctor
report.key_findings_desc: These are the findings from this report that may be worth mentioning at your next appointment.
report.no_key_findings: All results in this report are within the ranges shown.
report.pattern_cbc_intro: Some of these results are related to each other and may be worth considering together rather than independently.
report.symptom_context_heading: Does this match how you feel?
report.symptom_context_desc: You can optionally note any symptoms you've been experiencing. This can help you have a more focused conversation with your doctor.
report.symptom_placeholder: e.g. tiredness, dizziness, shortness of breath...
report.symptom_note: This information is not sent anywhere. It is only shown here to help you prepare for your appointment.
report.ask_ai_heading: Have a question about your report?
report.ask_ai_desc: You can ask CareAI about your results. Suggested questions:
report.ask_ai_prompt_1: Explain my results in simple words
report.ask_ai_prompt_2: Which result should I mention first to my doctor?
report.ask_ai_prompt_3: What questions should I ask my doctor?
report.extraction_desc: This shows how reliably each value was read from your report.
report.ref_range_note: Reference ranges can vary between laboratories and may depend on factors such as age, sex, pregnancy, testing method, and other circumstances. CareAI uses the range shown on your report whenever available.
report.sources_desc: General medical information used in this report is based on recognised health references including MedlinePlus, CDC, WHO, and standard laboratory medicine guidelines.
report.disclaimer_text: This report is designed to help you understand your laboratory results. It is not a diagnosis and cannot replace advice from a qualified healthcare professional. If you have concerning symptoms, or if your report contains a critical result, please seek appropriate medical care.
